title: "Can we reconstruct the FT A-10 Warthog within tolerance?"

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 2400.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 888.7      # s the probe actually used

mass_props = compute_mass_properties(airplane)
targets = evaluate_targets(airplane, mass_props)
worst_err_pct = max(abs(t["error_pct"]) for t in targets.values())
cg_target_val = targets["CG aft of wing LE"]["target"]
cg_model_val = targets["CG aft of wing LE"]["model"]
cg_err_pct = targets["CG aft of wing LE"]["error_pct"]
span_target_val = targets["Wingspan"]["target"]
span_model_val = targets["Wingspan"]["model"]
span_err_pct = targets["Wingspan"]["error_pct"]

battery_pack_mass_g = 380
n_views = 3
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_err_pct:.2f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[worst discrepancy across published targets (CG balance)]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The FT A-10 Warthog is reconstructed to within [`{python} f"{worst_err_pct:.2f}%"`]{.key} of all published targets. Projected wingspan matches the published [`{python} f"{span_target_val:.0f} mm"`]{.key} input at [`{python} f"{span_model_val:.1f} mm"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{span_err_pct:.2f}%"`]{.key} difference from panel dihedral). With the Flite Test Power Pack C twin powertrain and a standard [`{python} f"{battery_pack_mass_g:.0f} g"`]{.key} 4S pack placed in the forward nose compartment, predicted center of gravity lands [`{python} f"{cg_model_val:.1f} mm"`]{.key} aft of the wing root leading edge against the published [`{python} f"{cg_target_val:.0f} mm"`]{.key} target ([`{python} f"{cg_err_pct:.2f}%"`]{.key} error). All airframe surfaces align with reference photographs across [`{python} n_views`] camera angles (@fig-overlays), and every target sits well inside tolerance (@fig-targets).

::: {.callout-tip}
## New user specifications
1. **Powertrain**: Flite Test Power Pack C Twin.
:::

1. **Fuselage**: 8-station faceted box fitted to photographs.
2. **Empennage**: 480 mm stabilizer and twin vertical fins.
3. **Nacelles & pods**: twin aft nacelles and tractor pods.
4. **Dihedral**: 3.5 degrees outer panel dihedral.

```{python}
#| label: fig-targets
#| fig-cap: "Model discrepancy and target tolerance for published dimensions and derived balance."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

target_labels = ["Wingspan", "CG aft of LE"]
err_vals = [abs(targets["Wingspan"]["error_pct"]), abs(targets["CG aft of wing LE"]["error_pct"])]
tol_vals = [1.0, 7.8]

fig_targets, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 2.5))
y_ind = range(len(target_labels))
ax.barh(y_ind, err_vals, height=0.35, color="#1f77b4", label="Model discrepancy (%)")
ax.barh([y + 0.35 for y in y_ind], tol_vals, height=0.35, color="#aec7e8", alpha=0.7, label="Tolerance (%)")
ax.set_yticks([y + 0.175 for y in y_ind])
ax.set_yticklabels(target_labels)
ax.set_xlabel("Relative discrepancy (%)")
ax.set_xlim(0, max(tol_vals) * 1.2)
ax.legend(loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
